rest.notes: The REST surface spans TWO namespaces. 5 endpoints under 'buddypress/v1' come from 2 multi-method register_rest_route blocks in includes/bgr-bp-rest-integration.php (BGR_BP_REST_Integration::register_bp_review_routes). 2 endpoints under 'bgr/v1' come from 2 single-method register_rest_route blocks in includes/bgr-group-criteria-ajax.php (bgr_register_group_criteria_rest_routes on rest_api_init). 4 register_rest_route calls expand to 7 logical endpoints. Both GET review routes use read_reviews_permissions_check, which delegates to bgr_can_view_group_reviews() (includes/bgr-functions.php:198). Review update is REST-only: the front end offers no review editing (owner decision). Per-criterion averages are exposed only through the criteria REST route (includes/bgr-group-criteria-ajax.php:376) and the get_group_criteria AJAX payload (:257), not rendered in the UI. Review data is also attached to BP's own /groups response via bp_rest_groups_prepare_value (includes/bgr-bp-rest-integration.php:39), gated by bgr_can_view_group_reviews() (:98).

security.notes: AJAX: 16 authenticated wp_ajax_ actions (10 in includes/bgr-ajax.php, 6 in includes/bgr-group-criteria-ajax.php) plus exactly one nopriv action, bp_group_review_filter_ratings (17 add_action calls). Nonces: ajax-nonce (member-facing), admin-ajax-nonce (admin), bgr_group_criteria_nonce (per-group criteria). Admin handlers additionally check current_user_can('manage_options'); group-scoped handlers check groups_is_user_admin() || manage_options. REST uses per-route permission callbacks across both namespaces. CSV export is manage_options-gated (includes/bgr-filters.php:554). Admin feedback notice nonce-checked at admin/bgr-admin-feedback.php:237. Reviews of private/hidden groups are visible only to members and bp_moderate via bgr_can_view_group_reviews() (includes/bgr-functions.php:198), applied to REST, group header, directory, schema, widgets and the ratings filter.

functions.name: bgr_review_count_label

functions.name: bgr_get_group_review_stats

functions.name: bgr_can_view_group_reviews
functions.purpose: Visibility rule: public group => everyone; private/hidden => members and bp_moderate. Used by REST, header, directory, schema, widgets and the ratings filter.

functions.name: bgr_handle_review_decision
functions.purpose: draft/pending -> publish fires gamipress_bp_group_review + bgr_group_accept_review; draft/pending -> trash fires bgr_group_deny_review. Ignores non-group reviews (no linked_group).

functions.name: bgr_handle_review_submitted
functions.purpose: Shared post-submit side effects for the AJAX form and REST create.
